West Antarctica, latitude 77.4°S, from 95°W to 77°W. This is the Ellsworth Land interior, south of the Fletcher Peninsula and Abbot Ice Shelf, between the Pine Island Glacier basin and the Ellsworth Mountains. At 95°W the ice surface is roughly 1500 m. Moving east toward 86–80°W, the line approaches the Rutford and Evans basins, with surface around 1200–1500 m. Near 77°W it reaches the Sentinel Range west flank, where the ice surface is roughly 1500–2000 m. These are estimates on a gradual trend.

Latitude 77.3°S, longitude 95°W to 77°W lies in West Antarctica, between Ellsworth Land and the Pine Island Glacier region, on the West Antarctic Ice Sheet. Points further east, nearer 80°W, approach the Ellsworth Mountains and the Rutford Ice Stream area. The ice surface along this line is probably about 1200–1600 m.

1. In the west (95°W–90°W), near the Pine Island catchment, the surface is around 1300–1500 m.
2. In the middle (85°W–80°W), towards the Hudson Mountains/Fletcher Promontory area, it is likely about 1100–1400 m.
3. From 80°W to 77°W, nearer the Ellsworth Mountains and Rutford Ice Stream, it may drop towards 800 m by 77°W.

It then crosses the plateau toward the Ellsworth Land region near the Fletcher Peninsula area, at roughly 1000–1500 m. Near 80°W it reaches the base of the Ellsworth Mountains, around 1500–2000 m, and toward 77°W the ice surface comes down toward the Rutford/Ronne area. The figures follow a smooth trend.

Latitude -77.64°, longitude -95 to -77: this transect runs across West Antarctica, south of the Ellsworth Land coast. Along it lie the Hudson Mountains and the Pine Island Glacier interior, then the area toward the Ellsworth Mountains. The Sentinel Range sits near -86°, around 78–79°S. At -77.6°, longitude -86° is near the northern Sentinel Range, close to Mount Alf and the Minnesota Glacier area. The rest of the transect is ice sheet at roughly 1,000–1,600 m. To the east, near -80° to -77°, the Rutford/Evans area falls to around 500–1,000 m, continuing toward the Fowler Ice Rise and the Evans Ice Stream. These values are estimates from memory, not measured data.

Lat -77.96, lon -95 to -77: West Antarctica, around the Ellsworth Land area. The Ellsworth Mountains sit near 78-79°S, 85-90°W, though their northern part (Sentinel Range) is around 77.5-78.5°S, 86°W. Vinson is at 78.5°S, 85.6°W, and the Sentinel Range runs north toward roughly 77°S at 86°W. So this row likely crosses the Sentinel Range near 86°W, giving peaks of about 2,500-4,000 m. West of that lies the ice sheet at about 1,500-2,000 m, and further west near 95°W around 1,500 m. East of the range is the Rutford Ice Stream (about 84°W, low, ~500 m or less) and then the Fletcher Promontory / Ronne Ice Shelf edge. At 78°S, 80°W it may be Fletcher Promontory or Carlson Inlet, at roughly 300-700 m, and by 77°W perhaps the Ronne Ice Shelf at about 50 m.

At -79.77° latitude, from -95° to -77° longitude, the line runs across West Antarctica. It passes south of the Ellsworth Mountains, which lie around 78-79°S and 85°W, and near the Heritage Range at about 80°S, 82°W. Around 95°W, the area is the ice sheet near the Pine Island/Rutford divide, at roughly 1500 m. Rutford Ice Stream sits at about 80°S, 85°W, with the ice surface at about 200-500 m. The Heritage Range is at roughly 80°S, 81-83°W, with peaks reaching about 2000 m. East of about 80°W, the line reaches the Fletcher Promontory and the Ronne grounding zone, at about 300-600 m. These values are estimates from memory, not measured data.

-79.72 latitude, longitude -95 to -77. This is in West Antarctica, near Ellsworth Mountains region? Ellsworth Mountains are at ~78-79S, 85-90W... Vinson Massif at 78.5S, 85.6W. At 79.7S, south of Heritage Range (Heritage Range ~79-80.5S, 81-87W). Union Glacier ~79.75S, 83W. Ice surface ~700-900 m near Union Glacier. West of ~88W is the ice sheet interior near Institute Ice Stream / Rutford basin, elevation ~1200-1500 m. East of ~80W toward Ronne ice shelf grounding line (Institute ice stream / Hercules inlet ~80S, 78-80W), elevation low ~100-400 m. Hercules Inlet at 79.98S, 78W, sea level ice shelf ~50 m.

Rough profile: -95: ~1500; -90: ~1400; -88: ~1600 (Pirrit Hills ~81S,85W not here). Heritage Range peaks around -85 to -83: 1500-2000 m mountains; Union Glacier ~700 at -83. Then -81 to -79: ~800 to 400. -77: ~150.
